arena2_runs.description: Every judged run on the fixed bridge (the real bridge): twin seeds 0–2 for all 5 scenarios and 2 Gazebo curve_left runs per entry, with median gap, final gap, closest person range and target in view at the end.
arena2_runs.title: Arena 2 runs on the fixed bridge

arena2_scores.description: Points per part (lag 50, reliability 30, behaviour 20) from the frozen scorer score_entry_v2 (freeze 9b78f1f): the reference (hub code before the round) and the judge's scores for the Claude (3848164) and Codex (64dbe7f) entries.
arena2_scores.title: Arena 2 scores

arena3_runs.description: Every judged run of the 5 identity scenarios on both twin bridges (seeds 0-2) and in Gazebo, for the reference, Claude and Codex: final gap, share of time the target was in view, closest approach to the other person, contact and pass.
arena3_runs.title: Arena 3 runs with a second person

arena3_scores.description: Points per part (identity 50, following 30, behaviour 20) from the frozen scorer score_entry_v3 (freeze 08a7ac8) for the reference (code before Arena 3) and the judge's scores for the Claude (191d2c1) and Codex (4d22f41) entries, with identity runs passed.
arena3_scores.title: Arena 3 scores

arena_scores.description: Points from sim/arena/score_entry.py for each full run: before fix (1 run), Claude entry, Codex entry and the combined fix (3 runs each), run by Claude Code with the same script for every version.
arena_scores.title: Arena 1 scores

ci_runs.description: Snapshot of the offline-twin workflow runs (twin.yml) on GitHub, fetched 2026-10-30 12:50 Thai time (fetched_utc in each row) with tools/dashboard/ci/gen_ci.py --fetch. Not live status.
ci_runs.title: GitHub Actions runs

colour_clip_points.description: Torso Cb/Cr of sampled person boxes in every test video (two lab clips, five one-person clips, vtest crowd), with the clip and the person labelled by eye. Up to 900 boxes per clip (1500 for vtest).
colour_clip_points.title: Torso colour per clip and person

colour_heldout.description: Five one-person clips (parking lot in sun, greenhouse path in sun and shade). kept_own: share of the person's frames the robot's TargetGate keeps accepting, colour only. strangers: share of frames in which the person still scores above a box of a different person taken from another clip. Methods: Cb/Cr, H,S histogram alone, histogram + Cb/Cr with the histogram at a quarter weight (47553e5).
colour_heldout.title: Colour models on five held-out clips

colour_methods.description: Share of frames, with both people in view, in which each colour model scores the target highest (colour only, locked on the target's first box). Methods: current Cb/Cr, the paper's H,S GMM (N=10 and learned once), the H,S histogram alone, and histogram + Cb/Cr (TargetGate on claude/robot/hs-colour). Per target (blue or dark grey top) and clip.
colour_methods.title: Colour models on the two-person lab videos

colour_points.description: One row per person box in the two 2025-04-08 lab videos (10 fps, YOLOv8n): clip, person (blue top or dark grey top, labelled by eye), time, and the torso Cb/Cr measured as ros2_yolo_live does.
colour_points.title: Torso colour of two people (lab videos)

colour_separability.description: One row per clip and target (14): AUC that a target box costs less (colour only, against the robot gate's current model) than another person's box, for Cb/Cr only, H,S histogram only, and the gate's mix (histogram 0.25). Others: the other person in the lab clips, strangers from other clips for one-person clips, everyone in view for the vtest crowd. series and series_chroma (JSON text): per replay step, the target's cost and the nearest other's cost. points (JSON text): Cb/Cr of sampled boxes, T or O.
colour_separability.title: Colour separability per clip

colour_twin.description: One row per twin run on claude/robot/hs-colour (47553e5, histogram at a quarter weight): the colour set (shade_crossing, shade_side_by_side; clean and realism; seeds 0-9) and the identity and solo sets with realism (seeds 0-2), each with use_hs_hist true and false, plus identity and solo with bearing steering (histogram on). Pass, contact, final gap, target visible share.
colour_twin.title: Twin runs with the H,S histogram on and off

colour_vtest.description: Five recognisable people in a crowd video, labelled by eye. Per person and method (Cb/Cr, histogram alone, histogram + Cb/Cr at 0.25, GMM H,S N=10): share of frames, with someone else in view, in which the person scores best on colour alone. Chance is 17%.
colour_vtest.title: Colour models on OpenCV vtest.avi (PETS 2009 S2.L1)

colour_weights.description: The same TargetGate with only hist_weight changed: worst lab-clip target ranked first, worst held-out clip kept-own share, strangers ranked below own person, and vtest crowd overall ranked-first share.
colour_weights.title: Histogram weight sweep over all video sets

current_runs.title: Current code, every twin scenario
current_runs.description: One row per finished run of the whole-twin baseline (experiments/sim/scripts/run_baseline.sh): every scenario (solo, identity, colour, obstacle), realism profile, seeds 0-4, with the code on integration-hub (code column: 8b2ddf8, the merge of claude/workspace 2765354; runs on bdae2c1, same code). 110/110 passed, 0 contacts. Built by tools/dashboard/live/gen_current.py. Simulation, not the robot.

e7_ablation.description: Identity runs with each part switched off by a ROS parameter (full, no colour, no give-way, no gate), 5 scenarios × fixed/diff_drive × seeds 0-2, for the first run (2026-10-24) and the current code (2026-10-25); column round says which.
e7_ablation.title: E7 ablation

icp_trial_runs.description: One row per run: side_step_rows and side_step_bush, clean and realism, filter off or on with the ICP pose (c14fb1f + 1e802dc), bearing steering, seeds 0-4, two repeats (a, b). Pass, contact, final gap, target visible share; for ICP runs also ICP matches and failures, clusters dropped from LiDAR tracking as static, and the largest pose error against the twin's true pose.
icp_trial_runs.title: ICP static-filter trial runs

lidar_points.description: Points from /scan in the rosbag recorded during curve_left on the fixed bridge (combined code), every 0.5 s, within 8 m, turned into the robot frame (x forward, y left) using the 180° LiDAR mount. Simulation only.
lidar_points.title: LiDAR scan points

live_experiments.description: One row per twin experiment Claude runs: runs done, passed, failed, running, and the estimated time left. Claude refreshes it while runs are going.
live_experiments.title: Twin experiments, live

live_runs.description: One row per twin run of every experiment: scenario, seed, code version, realism, status and its score (final gap, share of time in view).
live_runs.title: Twin runs, live

live_scenarios.description: Each twin scenario: a Thai description, the people's waypoints, and any camera-blind windows, shade bands or clothing (from sim/twin/scenarios.py).
live_scenarios.title: Twin scenario layouts

live_tracks.description: Robot, target and other person positions (world frame, 2 Hz) and target gap for the finished runs of the experiment now running.
live_tracks.title: Twin tracks, running experiment

obstacle_paths.description: Robot (world x, y, heading, speed, turn rate, command), target and hidden person (world x, y) every 0.2 s for each run in obstacle_runs (pass_by and blind_corner, switch off and on, seeds 0-4). Built by tools/dashboard/live/gen_obstacle.py. Simulation, not the robot.
obstacle_paths.title: Obstacle stop/avoid: paths

obstacle_runs.description: One row per twin run comparing the obstacle switches on the current hub code (8b2ddf8, image from claude/workspace bdae2c1): pass_by with obstacle_avoid off/on and blind_corner with obstacle_stop off/on, realism, seeds 0-4, one run at a time. Pass, contact, closest distance to the hidden person and the robot pose at that moment. Built by tools/dashboard/live/gen_obstacle.py. Simulation, not the robot.
obstacle_runs.title: Obstacle stop/avoid: off vs on

past_tracks.description: Robot, target and other person positions (world frame, 1 Hz) and target gap for every run of finished twin experiments, for the replay.
past_tracks.title: Twin tracks, finished experiments

replay_paths.description: Robot (world x, y, heading, speed, turn rate), target and other person (world x, y) and whose box the camera published, every 0.4 s, for each run in replay_runs. Built by tools/dashboard/live/gen_replay.py. Simulation, not the robot.
replay_paths.title: Replay: before vs now, paths

replay_runs.description: One row per twin run of two whole-twin baselines on the follow, target-gate and colour scenarios, realism, seeds 0-4: before = hub 5c72c4d (before the LiDAR stop/avoid/assist work), now = hub 8b2ddf8. Pass, contact, final gap, share of time in view, closest person. Built by tools/dashboard/live/gen_replay.py. Simulation, not the robot.
replay_runs.title: Replay: before vs now, per run

robustness.description: Repeated curve_left / diff_drive runs across seeds in the kinematic twin and in Gazebo, counting runs where the robot lost the target (final gap about 3.1 m). Counted by Claude Code from its judging runs; not part of the Arena score.
robustness.title: Target-lost failures

scenario_results.description: One row per version × scenario × bridge from sim.twin.score on the same runs as the paths, now with the Arena 3 versions and the second-person scenarios.
scenario_results.title: Per-scenario results

solo_runs.description: Every single-person run on the m/s bridge: twin with the realism profile before the fixes, after them with the default sector steering, and with bearing steering (with the stale-message stop); the plain twin and Gazebo after the fixes. 10 walking moves × seeds 0-2.
solo_runs.title: Solo following runs

static_filter_map.description: Each side_step_bush run rebuilt as LiDAR scans once a second (twin geometry, no noise, three crop-row walls added for the picture only), with the robot pose from three sources: dead reckoning from /cmd_vel (with the bridge 1 s timeout), 2D ICP against a keyframe refreshed every second, and the true pose. Every point is labelled static or moving per pose source by matching scans 0.5-1.5 s earlier.
static_filter_map.title: Static-filter trial maps

static_filter_paths.description: Robot and target positions every 0.5 s in the twin's side_step_bush scenario, filter off and on (after the stale-command fix 08eb36b), three test sets, seeds 0-2, all from one image run one job at a time.
static_filter_paths.title: Static-filter trial paths

static_filter_runs.description: One row per run: side_step_bush (three test sets, filter off/on, seeds 0-2) and, as set regress, all 10 solo moves with realism and default steering (filter off/on, seeds 0-2); pass, contact, final gap, visible share, closest approach to the bush. Filter code after the stale-command fix 08eb36b.
static_filter_runs.title: Static-filter trial runs

trajectories.description: Robot and person positions every 0.5 s from the offline twin for 9 code versions: before fix, Arena 1 entries, combined, Arena 2 entries, the code before Arena 3 (Before A3, from E7's no-gate condition) and the Arena 3 entries (judge's seed-0 runs). Includes the 4 scenarios with a second person. Simulation only.
trajectories.title: Simulated robot and target paths

unit_tests.description: Every offline unit test in tests/ run with scripts/generate_dashboard_unit_tests.py on integration-hub @ 2ca77c2 (clean tree), 2026-10-30 12:50 Thai time; 208/208 pass. Each row carries branch, commit and run_utc. Not live status.
unit_tests.title: Unit test results
